content.short: Unstoppable Wallet is an open-source, non-custodial multi-wallet for Ethereum, Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Polygon, and other blockchains.
content.description: Unstoppable Wallet is an open-source, non-custodial multi-wallet that supports Ethereum, Bitcoin, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, and other blockchains. It provides non-custodial storage, a decentralized exchange, and extensive analytics for thousands of tokens and NFTs. The wallet is implemented with native code for Swift and Kotlin, delivering a cohesive, user-friendly way to store, send, and receive multiple cryptocurrencies in one place while maintaining full control of private keys and assets.
